main_text.head: SECT. V.
Exercitatio lectionis Æthiopicæ ex Psal. 117.
Alphabetum Armenum.
main_text.p: Habent Armeni, literas 38 quarum nomina figuræ & potestas tam in pronunciando quam in numerando ex sequenti Tabula con-stant.

page.notes: The Ethiopic lines are copied at low confidence from a blurred scan; each Ethiopic line is marked [?] as a whole and should be checked against the image. The transliterations below each Ethiopic line are legible and were copied as printed. The Latin Psalm text is copied as printed, with long s written as s. The heading "Exercitatio lectionis" carries a long s in the printed "lectionis" that was normalised to s. Printed "li eras" and "p teftas" have spacing gaps in the scan and were read as "literas" and "potestas".
